census.note: TCGA file names carry a barcode, not a marker, so 'named' is a lower bound on what is identifiable from the index alone; the stain is settled from pixels below

stain.rule: stain is called from hue fractions over tissue pixels: >15% DAB brown is dab-positive; >60% haematoxylin with almost no brown is haematoxylin-only

density.measures: nuclei density in haematoxylin-stained tissue -- CELLULARITY, not a proliferation index
not_measured: Ki-67 fraction (needs a Ki-67 IHC slide; see ki67_fraction)
a mitosis count, a grade, or any WHO criterion
anything about the patient the slide came from

slide_measured.ki67_refusal: Ki-67 fraction is not measurable from a 'haematoxylin-only' slide: the numerator (Ki-67 positive nuclei) requires a Ki-67 immunohistochemistry slide, and TCGA-GBM's slide images are not that (0 of 2,053 file names identify Ki-67 or IHC; a downloaded one is AppMag 5, MPP 2.0037, haematoxylin-only). No r0 is derived

selection: the smallest TCGA-GBM slide image by reported file size
stream2_status: MEASURED for cellularity; REFUSED for the Ki-67 ratio
